$$u\text{ finally blank}

u\notin P_i\cup T_i\quad\text{for every }i.

This is precisely the source-local blankness needed by the definition of  $X_i$ . Merely knowing  $u\notin P$  would not suffice.Let  $j$  be the positive source whose canonical tile is
$$Q=\{2,3\}\times\{2,3\},$$

$$v\in\{x,\zeta\}\cap P,$$

$$2x-y=(3,1)=p,\qquad
2\zeta-y=(1,3)=q.$$

The exactness of this source profile is what makes the strengthening work. The physical-slot count and parity argument are correctDefine the defect-slot pool by giving each physical defect tile its weight from the exact identity:one labelled unit for  $L_1$  or  $L_3$ ;two labelled units for  $L_{2\mathrm{bar}}$  or  $L_{2\mathrm{mutual}}$ .Its cardinality is exactly  $H$ .There are  $B$  distinct blank-gate tiles, each supplying two units. Acceptance and verification scopeThe first note establishes the claimed two-slot compensation, the all-reserve sufficient class, and the necessary  $A+A$  first-reserve census under its supplied complete-source dependencies. The essential strengthening comes from two independently valid deductions: every blank marked tile has weight two, and every zero-activation double with two occupied gates has two distinct forced defect tiles.The finite physical fixtures do not exercise the blank or single-activation branches, so they cannot supply evidence of realization or universal exclusion for those branches.
